problem: The R204 runner now embeds per-resource data and complete indexes in outcome, but its common final stdout prints that entire outcome without a byte bound.
root_cause: A complete on-disk evidence object is also used as the tool display object. T2 data volume is not bounded by its fixed seven-node count; token-budget increases cannot guarantee complete transport.

allowed_regions: One small pure formatting helper if needed
Replace only final common print with T2 bounded-summary branch and byte-identical original non-T2 print in else
scope.independent_work: Original seven T2 test source preparation may continue under R204. It is not an R206 modification target.
scope.forbidden: No product/test edits, no role/gate/command/schema/raw outcome/resource index/cleanup/timeout change, no new imports of product code or subprocesses.

summary_contract.ordering: Only after the unchanged full result.json write and author SPENT-ledger save, build a separate display dictionary. Do not mutate outcome or any persisted evidence.
summary_contract.result: Exact absolute path, bytes and SHA256 of the already written full result.json; use existing _t2_pin. It is the canonical full-result reference, not a self-hash inside result.
summary_contract.optional_fields: Only the existing stdout/stderr/junit/resource_summary path/bytes/SHA pin objects, or null if absent. No reservation message, exception message, raw strings, nested resources, indexes, full cleanup object or records[*].data in display.
summary_contract.bound: Serialize the complete display once and measure UTF-8 bytes INCLUDING the print newline before printing: <=6000 bytes.
summary_contract.fallback: If optional display would exceed the bound, use only schema_version, command_id, full result pin, display_omitted=true; construct and check this bounded record before printing. Exact R158 fixed result path and fixed scalars ensure it is small. Never slice/truncate serialized JSON or silently emit incomplete JSON.
summary_contract.semantics: No status/result mutation, numeric-exit relabel, error swallowing or acceptance claim. Missing/failed evidence stays the existing failure. Consumers must read the full pinned result; the summary cannot replace raw/JUnit/resources checks.
summary_contract.non_T2: The else branch remains exactly print(json.dumps(outcome, ensure_ascii=False)); non-T2 stdout content and return behavior remain unchanged.

before.rule: Exclusive full exact 20824-byte source archive before edit; verify full SHA940d... . Do not recreate/overwrite R204 limited diff/report or its prior a455 baseline.

preserve.full_evidence: Original invocation/stdout/stderr/result/resource-summary and file/temp indexes remain exactly governed by R204; no data omissions from disk.
preserve.previous_reports: R204 original report/diff/before and this original observation are immutable. New delta/report use R206 paths only.
preserve.other_semantics: All R158 exact argv/env/cwd,600-second child timeout,15-second cleanup contract, resource validation, reservation and per-command slots unchanged.

steps.action: Full-read plan/inputs and confirm runner20824/940d... still exact; T2 slots remain unreserved0/1. Native activation grants only this source edit.
Preserve full before, implement narrow T2 display helper/branch, save exact new diff and change report. No script execution/import/AST/compile/test.

Full-read final source and exact diff, normal stdlib byte/hash source gate. Verify all bytes outside allowed helper/print region unchanged; original non-T2 print literal retained; no scope/ledger/source drift. Check summary construction contains only permitted scalars/pins and UTF-8 bound is applied before output including newline.

Record new runner pin as the R204 source-preparation successor with explicit before archive; old R204 candidate SHA remains history. Resume original R204 source gates only. No T2 command released by this plan itself.

budget.normal_gate: Bounded ordinary stdlib file/text/hash/diff review and native metadata saves only; no dedicated validation script/pipeline or collector.

stop_conditions: Unexpected tool/source issue or wider required modification -> preserve and STOP for genuine Astra.
No verification by intentionally generating large output, running fake outcomes or invoking runner.
Any output consumer incompatibility beyond the explicit T2 compact-vs-full distinction requires separate source review; never pretend summary is full outcome.
